LanguageData.DepthRim.Nav.Label: Navigate
LanguageData.DepthRim.Nav.Desc:
Pick a tile on the world map, then the depth to end at: - This tile: change cruising depth, surface, or break through the ice - A neighbouring sea tile: anchor - An existing site: dock; once there and at its seafloor depth, choose where the hull stops - Any other sea tile: plan a voyage; confirming it starts the launch sequence Under way it changes the depth to end at; on the surface it picks how deep to dive. Each depth tier takes an hour, never below the seafloor, and the hull must be rated for it.
Seafloor here: {0} Hull rating: {1}
